historical_audit.methodology: Each assigned file is inventoried with tracked status, hash, classification, inspection method and retention reason. Full first-party reports were read; all lines of long manuscript snapshots and the raw AI digest were pattern-scanned with contextual review. Findings are confirmed representative examples, not an assertion that every awkward historical sentence is listed. Third-party text and legal terms were identified and preserved. Mathematical uses such as matrices commute, simple reflection, trivial subgroup, bibliographic titles, API names, numerical output and Markdown table separators were not treated as violations.
